issues.claim: at $38/hour (legal-secretary median $30.33 NJ 2025, ×1.25 benefits) / at $43/hour (paralegal median $34.38 NJ 2025, ×1.25 benefits)
issues.problem: Minor, non-blocking: the ×1.25 benefits load is an unsourced assumption sitting inside a parenthetical that otherwise reads as sourced data (the O*NET page gives wage rates only, no benefits load).
issues.fix: Write it as assumed, e.g. 'at $38/hour (NJ legal-secretary median $30.33 × an assumed 25% benefits load)', or add a one-line note under Sources such as 'benefits load: assumed 25%, not from O*NET'.

issues.claim: Impact high ends: about $18,100 / $61,800 / $51,500 a year
issues.problem: Minor, non-blocking: the top of each range is ~0.5-1% below the stated formula (480 h × $38 = $18,240; 1,440 h × $43 = $61,920; 1,200 h × $43 = $51,600). Rounding only, and it errs low rather than high, so nothing is inflated.
issues.fix: Optional: round to $18,200 / $61,900 / $51,600, or leave as is and keep the 'about' wording.

issues.claim: Intake is advertised 24/7 [manalapan] and one email, contact@ram.law, serves all three offices, with no portal, scheduling calendar or status lookup [contact]
issues.problem: Minor, non-persuasive omission (not an error): the audit never mentions the firm's own online 'Free Case Review' intake funnel (a button on every page pointing to ramlawnj.lawbrokr.com). A reader at the firm will notice its absence, and it slightly weakens the 'channels are thin' framing.
issues.fix: Add a few words such as 'a web free-case-review button aside' to the 'Now' line, so the description matches what the firm knows it has.

issues.claim: The agent: Answers calls and forms in English or Spanish ... acceptance stays a lawyer's call.
issues.problem: Optional strategic note, not a factual error: the firm publishes a 'Client Experience' page promising that a caller 'will not be trapped in an endless loop of automated messages' and 'will speak directly with a member of our team', plus same-business-day callbacks. An unsolicited audit proposing an AI first responder touches that promise without acknowledging it.
issues.fix: Consider one clause in the section 1 'The agent' line or the opener: e.g. 'every call warm-transfers to a person on the published terms you promise'. No change required for accuracy.
